notes: 'only so' is taken whole on μόνον headed on 'only', matching 5:3 in the same chapter (rule 24).
καυχώμενοι is a participle rendered as a finite clause with an unexpressed subject, so the supplied 'we' rides with it (rule 74).
τῷ before θεῷ is `unrepresented` for want of an English determiner (rule 23), while τοῦ before κυρίου is displaced by ἡμῶν → 'our' (rule 20).
